headline: Ten weeks in —
still 32 clear
body: Wirtz scored, assisted and took max bonus for 13, and Groß added 10. Umar matched his 51 and gained nothing.
His one waiver move was Mitoma, who was injured when he signed him and spent the week on the bench. When you're 32 clear, you can afford to buy things you can't use.

headline: Three weeks running —
the wrong goalkeeper
body: Kinsky started and got 2. Verbruggen got 6 on the bench. That's three weeks in a row, and Verbruggen is entitled to ask what else he has to do.
Le Fée got 11 and the team put up 51, which would normally be a statement. Imad also scored 51. The gap is still 32.

headline: Gonzalo or Awoniyi —
both 2, as it turns out
body: After two weeks of picking the wrong one, Rihab finally found a week where it didn't matter. Gonzalo started, Awoniyi sat, and they both scored 2.
Vuskovic carried the team with 12. Third place, 34 behind Umar and 18 ahead of Vidhun: too far back to dream, too far ahead to worry.

headline: 113 in two weeks —
then 35
body: After the best fortnight in the league, Vidhun scored 35, the second-lowest this week. Thiago finished on -2, which is hard to do even on purpose.
N. Jackson got 11, and that's the only reason fourth place survived. It's now one point clear of Split the G FC, who have Barry in form.

headline: Barry 16 —
fourth is one point away
body: Barry scored twice against Coventry, set up a third and took max bonus: 16, the best individual score this week.
Then there's Flemming, dropped and re-signed by the same manager inside a fortnight. His reward for coming back was a seat on the bench and a 0.

headline: Top score of the week —
with three starters missing
body: Three of Munir's starters didn't play at all. The bench came on for 12, McGinn got 10, Cherki got 9, and the total was 59, the best in the league.
McGinn is the man he dropped Bruno Fernandes for, and Bruno got 10 for Sandaru, so the trade is level for now. Up to sixth, and Munir will be telling everyone it was the plan.

headline: Scores 49 —
drops a place anyway
body: Delap scored twice against Man City for 13 and Ødegaard got 11. A good week, and Dulaj still went from sixth to seventh because Munir picked this week to post 59.
Every other manager in the league has made a waiver claim in the last two windows. Dulaj hasn't made one. Either total faith in the squad or he's never found the button.

headline: Defence: 29 —
attack: 1
body: Roefs 9, Konsa 8, Castagne 7. Up front, Igor Jesus and Solanke managed 1 between them.
Both of Ometh's waiver claims this week were defenders. A bold read of a team whose defence just outscored its attack 29 to 1.

headline: Already ran the 10k —
now eyeing the big one
body: 34 points, the lowest of the week. Trafford got 10 on the bench while Lammens started in goal for 1.
Samithu already did the first forfeit and ran the 10k. Sandaru is now just 7 points behind him, and the big forfeit for finishing 10th is still on the table.

headline: An hour staring at a wall —
two gameweeks to dodge it
body: The next mini forfeit is an hour staring at a wall, and right now Sandaru is the one booked in for it. Two gameweeks left to get out of it.
Signing Bruno Fernandes helped: 10 on debut, and the gap to ninth is down from 14 to 7. The wall is still the favourite.
